g.text: REVISION 2 — regional production design. Sizes, quotas, prices, compatibility and failover still need proof.
Solid: request / read Dashed: channel delivery Amber: product rule Proposed, not deployed
GCP REGION — proposed us-central1; managed regional services
* Verify runtime/region fit early. Fallback: regional VM group; no pretend HTTP listener on a worker.
Warm standby is not zero-loss regional click capture. Real evidence: recovery, durable-event reconciliation, load and cost.
